exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 A Volunteer Interview
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Interviewer: Welcome, Xu Yuan. May I ask why you want to volunteer with us?
Xu Yuan: I really want to help people in my community and learn new skills.
Interviewer: That's good. What do you think your greatest strength is?
Xu Yuan: I'm patient, so I'm good at working with children and older people.
Interviewer: I see. Do you have any free time at weekends?
Xu Yuan: Yes, I'm free every Saturday morning.
Interviewer: Wonderful. We'll let you know whether you've been chosen by Friday.
Xu Yuan: Thank you so much. I really hope I can join your team.
exercises.translation_cn: 面试官欢迎徐媛并问她为何想做志愿者;徐媛说想帮助社区、学新技能;她认为自己最大的优点是有耐心,擅长和孩子与老人相处;周六上午有空;面试官说周五前通知是否被选上;徐媛希望能加入。

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Benefits of Volunteering
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Volunteering brings many benefits to the people who do it.
It can develop a more positive attitude towards life.
It is also good for your health and helps you make new friends.
But it only helps if the work means something to you.
If it feels like a chore, it will bring you little joy.
exercises.translation_cn: 做志愿服务给参与者带来许多好处;能培养更积极的人生态度;也有益健康并帮你结交新朋友;但只有当这份工作对你有意义时才有帮助;若它像苦差事,就带不来多少快乐。

questions.stem: What attitude can volunteering develop?
options: A more positive attitude towards life.

questions.stem: Besides health, what else does volunteering help with?
When does volunteering really help you?
options: When the work means something to you.

questions.stem: What happens if the work feels like a chore?
What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Volunteering helps you if the work matters to you.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Choosing Volunteer Work
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lily: I want to start volunteering, but I'm not sure where to begin.
Tom: Think about what you really care about first.
Lily: Well, I love animals. Maybe I could help at a shelter.
Tom: That's a great idea. They always need people to feed and walk the dogs.
Lily: Do you think they would mind that I'm only sixteen?
Tom: Not at all. Many young people volunteer there.
Lily: Then I'll ask whether they need helpers this weekend.
Tom: Good. Choose work you enjoy, and it won't feel like a chore.
exercises.translation_cn: 莉莉想做志愿者却不知从何开始;汤姆建议先想想自己真正在意什么;莉莉喜欢动物,想去收容所帮忙;汤姆说那里总缺喂狗、遛狗的人;莉莉担心自己才十六岁;汤姆说很多年轻人都在那做;莉莉决定问问周末是否需要帮手;汤姆说选喜欢的工作就不会像苦差事。

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 A Call for Volunteers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Our summer camp is looking for volunteers, and we need you.
Volunteers will help to organise games and keep the children safe.
You should be creative, responsible and full of energy.
The work runs from nine in the morning to four in the afternoon.
If you are interested, please send an email to the camp leader today.
exercises.translation_cn: 我们的夏令营正在招募志愿者,需要你;志愿者将帮助组织游戏并确保孩子的安全;你应有创意、有责任心、充满活力;工作时间从上午九点到下午四点;有意者请今天给营地负责人发邮件。

questions.stem: What is the summer camp looking for?

options: Organise games and keep children safe.

questions.stem: What kind of person should a volunteer be?

options: From nine in the morning to four in the afternoon.

questions.stem: How should interested people reply?
options: By sending an email to the camp leader.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Visiting the Care Home
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: How was your visit to the care home today?
Ben: It was lovely. I spent the whole afternoon talking with an old man named Mr Green.
Anna: That sounds nice. What did you talk about?
Ben: He told me how he had worked as a teacher for forty years.
Anna: Did he enjoy your visit?
Ben: Yes, he asked me whether I could come back next week.
Anna: Of course you should! These visits clearly mean a lot to him.
Ben: They mean a lot to me too. I learn something new from him every time.
exercises.translation_cn: 安娜问本今天去敬老院怎么样;本说很愉快,整个下午都在和一位叫格林先生的老人聊天;聊到老人当了四十年老师;老人很喜欢这次探访,还问本下周能否再来;安娜鼓励他去;本说这些探访对他自己也意义重大,每次都能学到新东西。

options: She tells him to stop visiting.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 International Volunteer Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Every year, the world celebrates International Volunteer Day on the fifth of December.
On that day, millions of people give their time to help others.
Some clean up parks, while others donate blood or visit the elderly.
These actions remind us that anyone can make a difference.
Even a single afternoon of help can bring a community closer together.
exercises.translation_cn: 每年世界在12月5日庆祝国际志愿者日;那天数百万人付出时间帮助他人;有人清理公园,有人献血或探望老人;这些行动提醒我们人人都能带来改变;哪怕只是一个下午的帮助,也能让社区更紧密。
